_comment: Ground truth for the eval scorer (Recall@10 / MRR) + the hybrid-ordering assertion (PLAN §5 step 5). The `relevant` ids are human/behaviour labels (NOT an LLM's opinion — DISPUTE D / dsip noSelfGrading). `hybridOrderingProof` is the paraphrase case that proves hybrid != BM25-alone: under BM25-alone d08 ranks first (literal query words), under hybrid d07 ranks first (semantic match via fixture vectors).

judgements.query: remove containers from a node when it runs low on memory

hybridOrderingProof.query: remove containers from a node when it runs low on memory
hybridOrderingProof.note: BM25-alone favours d08 (has the literal words remove/containers/memory); hybrid favours d07 (eviction under memory pressure — the semantic match). The flip is the proof that fusion_mode=='hybrid' changes the ordering.

lexicalIdRanking.note: the RTX-4090 doc (d02) must rank above the RTX-4070 doc (d03) — dense embeddings cluster near-identical SKUs, BM25 keeps them apart (O4/S1).
